runner_up: Split the registry into per-glyph import() loaders so each tab chunk carries only its own art — a real client-bundle win, but check-budget.mjs counts import() so the page ceiling does not move; traded away for the card that actually frees the budget.
body:
## Summary
Traced /motionize art is data, not code, yet 274 KB of it rides the workspace page's static import graph because every empty state imports a `glyphs/*Glyph.ts` module for value. Serve the art by id from one server-side catalog over `GET /api/glyphs/[id]`, have `MotionizedGlyph` take a `glyph` id and fetch through a cached loader, and the 13 data modules leave `app/page.tsx`'s graph entirely.

## Description
`glyphRegistry.ts` statically imports 10 traced modules and `ChainEmptyState` imports the registry, so even the icon-only Agents empty state pulls the whole set; 11 feature empty states import their module directly. `check-budget.mjs` walks static AND dynamic imports, so lazy `import()` does not help the budget — the data has to leave the client graph. The move: (1) `glyphRegistry.ts` becomes the closed vocabulary — `GLYPH_IDS` literal array + `GlyphId` union + `isGlyphId` Set guard (the house shape of tabs.ts / task-kinds.ts) plus the tab->id map, importing no art; (2) new `glyphCatalog.ts` (server-only) maps id -> the untouched generated modules; (3) new `app/api/glyphs/[id]/route.ts` answers the TracedGlyph as JSON with a long private cache header, 404 with a code for an unknown id, on the default gated side; (4) new `glyphLoader.ts` — pure url + in-memory promise cache + shape validation, failure -> null and not cached; (5) `MotionizedGlyph` takes `glyph: GlyphId`, renders the empty square `<svg viewBox>` until the paths arrive, then plays the entrance exactly as today (the reveal is already an arrival animation); (6) the 12 render sites swap `data={X.data} viewBox={X.viewBox}` for `glyph="x"`; (7) `glyphsHaveConsumers.test.ts` counts an id reference in a render site as the consumer; (8) `perf-budget.json` is tightened with `--tighten` in the same change.

## Flow
Empty tab mounts -> `<MotionizedGlyph glyph="decisions">` renders its sized, aria-hidden svg shell -> `loadGlyph('decisions')` hits the promise cache or fetches `/api/glyphs/decisions` once -> paths render and the staggered entrance runs -> the next mount of any empty state with that id is served from the cache. Fetch fails -> the shell stays empty; the heading, body and CTA (which carry the meaning) are unaffected.

## Expected impact
`app/page.tsx` drops 13 modules and ~274 KB (1371/8730 ceiling; ~8450 KB after), the largest single-context cut available on the page every operator waits on, and the headroom the last four ceiling raises spent. Each tab chunk that shows an empty state stops shipping 20-36 KB of path strings as JS to parse; the art arrives only when an empty state actually renders. The generated modules, the motionize emitter and `glyphData.test.ts`'s data contract stay exactly as they are.

## Evaluation
Claim: traced glyph path data is off the workspace page's import graph and every empty state still renders its art by id.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass.
After: 8 of 8.
Method: gate — node:test cases in glyphLoader.test.ts / glyphRegistry.test.ts (including a walkGraph assertion), `npm run test:perf`, `npm run api:check`, `npm run test:unit`.
Result: pending build.
Gate: architecture

the client already has the data: app/features/shell/tasks/tasksProviderTypes.ts:39 `running: Task[]`, :24-25 progressDone/progressTotal on every polled task, :77 `loadFailed` ('a view MUST NOT render that [] as nothing has run'), :80 ACTIVE predicate

app/_components/glyph/motionPresets.ts:100-103 defines ambient 'pulse' as 'Only for surfaces where work really is happening … otherwise it lies'; grep 'ambient=' across app/ finds one site (MatrixEmptyState.tsx:127, 'float') — pulse has no consumer, against the file's own rule at :35-37 ('a preset needs a real consumer, not a prop')

rollback: Additive and self-contained: a new pure module + test, one component branch, four catalog key sets and a doc paragraph. Reverting the commit restores the unconditional 'caught up' render; no schema, route or shared primitive changes.
runner_up: Show a pending-arrival state on the Matrix and Analytics empty states while 'analyze' tasks run — deferred because this scout could not verify from source that a finished analyze deposits into those surfaces' counts, and a false 'arriving' is the same lie turned around.
body:
## Summary
While an AI screen of 120 candidates is running, the Decisions tab tells the recruiter "You're all caught up. No decisions are waiting on you right now." and offers two ways to leave. The app already polls exactly the tasks that will fill this queue. Make the empty state claim the right kind of empty: 'screening in progress — N/M screened, decisions land here' with a link to the live run, and the decisions glyph breathing on the `pulse` preset that exists for exactly this and has never had a consumer.

## Description
New pure module `app/_components/glyph/glyphArrival.ts`: `ARRIVAL_KINDS` (a `Partial<Record<GlyphRegistryTabId, readonly TaskKind[]>>`, today `decisions: ['batch_screen', 'automation']`, keyed by the existing closed vocabularies so tsc rejects a typo), `resolveArrival({ tab, tasks, loadFailed })` -> `idle | arriving{count, done, total}` using the provider's ACTIVE predicate, and `ambientFor(arrival)`. `DecisionsEmptyHandoff` reads `useTasks()`, resolves the arrival, and when arriving swaps the eyebrow/title/body for the arriving copy (with a determinate `done/total` when the task reports one), passes `ambient="pulse"` to the glyph, and adds a 'Watch it run' link to the tasks tab; the destination cards and the reconsider button stay. Idle is today's surface, unchanged. A frozen queue (`loadFailed`) never claims an arrival. When the task finishes, the existing live refresh reloads the queue and the real entries replace the empty state.

## Flow
Recruiter clicks 'AI-screen all matched' on the pipeline -> opens Decisions before the first result lands -> sees 'Screening in progress — 3 of 10 screened. Decisions land here as each one finishes.' with the fork glyph pulsing and a link to Background tasks -> first decisions arrive via useLiveRefresh -> the queue renders. Without a running task the recruiter sees today's 'caught up' handoff.

## Expected impact
Closes a false completion claim on the surface where the recruiter decides whether to wait or leave, at the exact moment a paid AI run is in flight. Gives the motion system's activity preset its one honest consumer. The seam (tab -> depositing task kinds) is where later surfaces opt in once their deposit path is verified, instead of each empty state wiring useTasks ad hoc.

## Evaluation
Claim: the Decisions empty state distinguishes 'nothing is coming' from 'screening in flight', from data the client already polls, and never claims arrival from a stale queue.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass.
After: 8 of 8.
Method: gate — node:test over glyphArrival.ts and motionPresets.test.ts, `npm run i18n:check`, `npm run test:unit`, `npm run test:perf`.
Result: pending build.
Gate: none
